title: Three Evenings and One Short Cup
subtitle: 待客之道 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 待客之道（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）
meta: 主题语境：待客之道（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·良好的人际关系与人际交往）　|　核心词汇：guest　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guest 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the host ① welcomed a guest that no neighbour in the court would have described, and he said the welcoming was the whole of the evening. The ② guest, meaning the visitor himself and not the invitation, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; a guest, he said, is the only thing in a court that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guest in that court had the same short cup beside him, and the ④ guest at the far table, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guest, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the host said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guest was the whole of the matter, meaning the stranger and not the visitor. The ⑥ guest, meaning the stranger and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guest, he said, is either something you welcome or the only word that means both a visitor and a stranger. He said the stranger is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ guest had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short cup. The ⑧ guest of the whole thing, the host wrote in November, was one court and three evenings of describing; guest, he said, is either the one at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guest I remember is the one described in the register, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the court. A ⑩ guest, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being described; every guest, she said, is a stranger that has agreed to look like a visitor. She said the stranger was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 客人；宾客（指院里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 客人；宾客（指那个人本人，与请柬相对）
C. 固定搭配：welcome a guest 迎接一位客人
D. n. 客人（指留给孩子们学着招呼的那一位）
E. n. 宾客（抽象总称，指一处院子的待客之事）
F. n. 客人（指登记簿里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 陌生人；外来者（指一件事里人人都见却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 生客（抽象总称，指人人都见却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: welcomed a guest that no neighbour in the court would have described
The guest, meaning the visitor himself and not the invitation
the guest at the far table
the guest was the whole of the matter
the guest had become a line in a register
The guest of the whole thing
A guest, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: welcome a guest 意为“迎接一位客人”，1967 年那位主人迎接了院里没有一位邻居肯描述的一位客人。
guest 意为“客人、宾客”，指那个人本人而不是请柬，他经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
guest 意为“客人、宾客”，指院里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一只矮矮的杯子。
guest 意为“客人”，指最远那张桌边留给孩子们学着招呼的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guest 意为“陌生人、外来者”，指一件事里人人都见却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位生客就是那件事的全部。
guest 意为“生客”，指人人都见却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位客人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guest 意为“客人”，指登记簿里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1972 年这一位成了簿上的一行。
guest 意为“宾客”，主人十一月写道，整件事的待客之事是一处院子和三个傍晚的描述。
guest 意为“客人”，我记得的是登记簿里描述过的那一位，1974 年离开了，至今仍被说成院里最安静的一位。
guest 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一位客人是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的宾客。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年那位主人迎接了院里没有一位邻居肯描述的一位客人，他说迎客才是那个傍晚的全部。（welcome a guest）
那位客人，指的是那个人本人而不是请柬，经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被描述。（guest）
那处院里每一位客人旁边都有同一只矮矮的杯子。（guest）
最远那张桌边那位客人，指的是他们留给孩子们学着招呼的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（guest）
叔叔说这位生客就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位客人。（guest）
1976 年母亲说，一位客人是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的宾客。（guest）

Every guest in that court had the same short cup beside him.
The guest at the far table, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the guest was the whole of the matter, meaning the stranger and not the visitor.
